notes.title: "Immortus Temporus" is now available on Steam!
notes.content:
Dear Players,

At the end of 2020, [url=https://store.steampowered.com/news/app/491720/view/4498498185069811906]I told you[/url] that I was ready to move on to a more ambitious project, and... Today the game I was hoping to make officially became available on Steam! 

[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1609030]Immortus Temporus[/url] is an action puzzle for people who love to find optimal ways to complete the game and beat it faster than anybody else. Most of the levels in "IT" have multiple solutions, which require players to think outside of the box and break the rules of this game. For instance, if you crash into a hazard, you will deactivate it for the duration of the level and teleport back to the spawn point, which might help you get where you want faster.

I'm super proud of "Immortus Temporus" and I'm 100% certain that it's the best project I've ever worked on. I'm excited to release this game to the public eye, and I'd love to hear your thoughts about it! ːsteamhappyː

If you'd like see how this game feels to play, please check out this let's play by Rayk: [previewyoutube=bsDI2hYRzck;full][/previewyoutube]
If you are curious about how this game was made, I made two 5-minute-long devlogs on my YouTube channel, where I tried to describe how this game came to life and how I came up with its puzzles:
[previewyoutube=LuQ1P8ewn7g;full][/previewyoutube]
[previewyoutube=71Yg_WZeCx4;full][/previewyoutube]
And if you'd like to get weekly summaries of what I'm working on, as well as take a peek "behind the things" of what I'm doing, please consider following me on [url=https://www.patreon.com/Khud0]Patreon[/url]!

Thank you for reading this announcement, have a splendid day! ːgrizzland_heartː

Yours forever,
Ivan Zlobin (Khud0)

notes.title: Shatris is now available on Steam!
notes.content:
Dear Players,

If you told me a bit more than a year ago that some day I'll release a puzzle game, I'd doubt your words. What happened instead is that I now have 2 puzzle games on Steam, released in the same year! Ladies and gentlemen, meet [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1301830/Shatris_Infinite_Puzzles/]Shatris[/url]!

The reason I made [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1227860/Plastris/]Plastris[/url] is that I wanted to get used to a new game engine. I decided to transition from GameMaker to Unity and didn't want to make some engine-specific mistakes on a big and ambitious project, so I thought that the easiest game genre to release would be a puzzle. Nonetheless, I enjoyed developing it because I could work together with my girlfriend and design this game using just paper, pen and sometimes dried peas while I was at home, on a bed or even on a bus.

The reason I made [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1301830/Shatris_Infinite_Puzzles/]Shatris[/url], however, was because I wanted to improve on the previous game. I felt like I didn't push it to its full potential and I wanted to make something that is similar, but better. I wholeheartedly believe that I managed to achieve that, but obviously it's not my opinion that matters. :) Thus, in case you're interested in puzzle games, I hope that you'll try it out yourselves and share your thoughts with me.

Now I finally feel like I've learned enough to start something ambitious and I hope to meet you again in 2021. :) I have a few prototypes ready, but I still haven't decided what exactly the upcoming game of mine will look like. However, there's a 90% chance that it will be controller-based and 2 players will be able to play it on the same couch.

Thank you for reading this announcement, I wish each single one of you to have fantastic winter holidays and only the best of luck in the upcoming year!

Yours forever,
Ivan Zlobin (Khud0)

notes.title: v1.12 - Everything is in its Place
notes.content:
Dear Players,

Next year, I will be focused on making new games. This is an update, released to celebrate entering the New Year of 2020. I planned to make and release it a couple of months ago, but I couldn't find "the right time" to do it.

Almost every fixed bug was initially discovered by UNICOY, a bright person and a speedruner the world has never seen before. ;)

[h2]Change Log[/h2]
1. All of the 3 endings should be accessible as intended.
2.1. Rockets you'll meet on the last level of the game now properly damage players again.
2.2. "Big Rockets" stay big if you fail to destroy them.
3. Vertical screenshake was removed, because it used to look very ugly. Horizontal screenshake is now stronger.
4. Progress on the bar should (?) be more accurate, though it may look weird.
5. An issue that could sometimes kill you upon finishing the level was resolved.
6. Weird tile on the last block in the room shouldn't appear anymore.
6.1. Obstacles can still be placed at the "finish line", but that shouldn't affect the gameplay anymore.

See you next year! 

Yours forever,
Khud0

notes.title: v1.01 - Players' Contribution!
notes.content:
Nary has been out for 2-3 days now and I've gathered enough feedback to come up with a new update and a few slight fixes.

This update is fully community-suggested, so I will leave nicknames/initals of the people who helped me to come up with these ideas. And I encourage you to share your ideas [url=https://steamcommunity.com/app/491720/discussions/0/360670708786884092/]here[/url] :)

Here's [u]the list of stuff done[/u] in a format "What - (Who Suggested)"

1. A Progress bar on the levels. Now you can see how close you were to the End of the level when you got your face into the obstacle. - (Originally by my GF, enhanced by a talk from Edmund McMillen).

2. Tutorial is now properly shown immediately when you first launch the game. - (Rami Ismail).

3. I haven't removed the Heads (Lives) as Rami suggested, because they play 3 important roles in the Game. But I have added +1 Head ^^. 

4. "Start" button is now the default one in focus after losing, so you don't have to click 7 times to start playing again - (Ivan G.)

5. Players are now reminded to buy stuff from the Shop in the Tutorial. - (Aleksander M.)

6. The Shop should no longer cause an error under certain circumstances - (Various Players).

7. Control Remap function was removed because it stopped working. I will focus on improving and re-implementing the feature. - (Nikolay Ch.)

8. Chain-Jumping is now allowed, which also fixes the moments when sometimes players would say that "the spacebar doesn't work" - (Ostap B. and Ivan G.)

v1.02 Mini-Changes:

1. Jump / Land / Special animations. 
2. More SFX variety.

See you all in the next Update! :nary_heart:

notes.title: The Undead Edition is now OUT!
notes.content:
Greetings Players!

I'm [b]proud[/b] to introduce [u]the new era of Nary[/u]!
[b]The Undead Edition update is finally out![/b]

I have added the finishing touches to the Game and I'm looking forward to seeing your Reviews!
___________

Here's the [b]Big List of Updates[/b]:

1. New, much more responsive [u]Controls[/u] and [u]Jump Mechanics[/u].

2. A whole [u]new Level[/u] and a specific Skill were added to the Game.

3. 3 Levels and Foes were [u]re-drawn[/u] + the Boss was re-introduced.

4. [u]Curses![/u] Now Nary's Head can get one of 5 Curses that slightly modify the experience.

5. Tons of new Particles and other [u]Visual and Sound Effects[/u].

6. [u]Slopes[/u] and new Obstacles were added.

7. [u]Transformations![/u] Players can now combine unlocked Items to turn into one of the two in-game Transformations.

8. Visual items! Some items are shown in-game now.

9. [u]An Offer from a Stranger[/u] can now appear between the Levels and influence the Gameplay.

10. Menu and Game Start Menu are drastically changed.

11. [u]New Modes[/u] were added + [u]Items[/u] system was reworked.

12. I'm super sorry for that, but the old [u]Achievements[/u] were removed and replaced with the new ones. I sincerely hate it when developers do that to the games I play, but just trust me that it was an absolute necessity.

13. The Story was completely removed because of how dumb it was, though there are now [u]3 interesting Endings[/u].

14. A new [u]Shop[/u] and its mechanics. Now Players can actually understand how to buy new Modes! :D

15. Cursor and Mouse Input were completely removed from the Game.

16. Trails were removed, now each shot has a Random one.

17. Slightly faster Loading Time that allows for generating new obstacles for each Head (life).

18. New UI and Herbs/Orbs system.

19. New [u]Font[/u] was specifically created for the Game.

20. Loading Screen now says useful things.

21. Trophies Room is now much easier to understand.

22. [u]Tutorial[/u] is re-introduced.

___________

And those are not all of the changes! I encourage you to run Nary and find the others for yourself ;)
___________

If you want to Support me - please, leave an [u]honest[/u] Review of the game and follow my [url=https://twitter.com/Khud0Steam]Twitter![/url] :nary_heart:
___________

I hope that you will enjoy the new Update!
See you on the Forum and in the Reviews section! :nary_trophy:

notes.title: Looking for things to update.
notes.content:
Hi,

I have been working on various IRL stuff as well as my new game lately, but I decided to dedicate some of the time to make a new Nary update.

Even though, honestly, Nary turned out to only be interesting to a small circle of people, I believe that it can be resurrected and re-introduced to the public.

The stuff that I believe should be given a rewamp:
- Overall difficulty of the game;
- User Interface;
- General bug fixing and review of the mechanics;

But the main idea of this post is that all of the above makes no sense without actual people interested in that. Thus, I ask you to write any suggestions about how the game should look like for you to re-visit it and to give it a second chance.

It can be done [url=https://steamcommunity.com/app/491720/discussions/0/360670708786884092/]in this forum section[/url].

I will make sure to consider any of the ideas.
Thanks a lot in advance! :nary_heart:

Yours,
Khud0.

notes.title: Update #12 - Less mouse usage = More fun!
notes.content:
This update was made thanks to an [url=http://steamcommunity.com/profiles/76561198040056045]awesome player[/url] who was not afraid to express his thoughts, ideas and bugs he witnessed on game's forum. [b]Thank you, Arkabed![/b]

[b]What's new?[/b]

- Now you don't go to the menu after "free restart" (you restart immediately with previously chosen parameters) and all you need to play is to set all the modificators once in a session and play for as much as you want without interruption! 

- Death screen can be navigated with keyboard/gamepad, so no more mouse touching is required! Just press any arrow key to get access to keyboard/gamepad navigation and then use Jump button to choose.

[b]Bugfixes[/b]

- Now the projectiles are always destroyed when you kill their creators;
- Left shoulder on gamepad is now left item (sword), right is shield.
- Random "Fast as Lightning" achievement unlock fixed;
- Some more minor ones;

There are still quite a few things to be done, but I tried to cover the most essential ones in this update.

[b]Hope that you'll enjoy![/b] ːnary_shieldː
See you in the next one!

notes.title: Update #10 - Mini
notes.content:
-> "Outrageous" achievement

I have received a message that "Outrageous" achievement doesn't work for some players. That's why the [spoiler]Alt+F4[/spoiler] combination doesn't make an attempt to close the game anymore. 

Also, if you're still having troubles with this achievement, here's the new keyboard combination which will also give it to you: [spoiler]Alt+F (letter)[/spoiler]

-> A little change to the Shop

Now you can go to the shop even when you only have one heart left so that you can replenish it when you are "dead". If you are trying to escape the shop with one heart, you will get a message that you can't do it.

Even though it is a really small update, I believe that it covers some important mechanics and I hope that it will be useful for you!

See you in the next one!  ːnary_shieldː

notes.title: Update #6 - Testers required!
notes.content:
[h1] Finally! [/h1]

[h1] Controller Support! [/h1]

Update #6 was a huuuge trouble and I hope that everything is working as it should be. In ordrer to check if it is, I desperately need your help!

If you have some spare time, please, check if the gamepad support is working.

As I've stated before, I don't have a controller on my own, so I don't know if it is working well at the moment. I just made sure that the update didn't break anything that was previously in the game and added some new cool stuff!

Here's the list of controls:

[b]LEFT SIDE:[/b]
1) Arrows still remain as an attack type.

[b]RIGHT SIDE:[/b]
1) Bottom button is for jumping.
2) Left and right buttons are responsible for special abilities. Use any of them on the Forest or Cave/Dungeon levels in order to see if it is working. 
3) Top button pauses the game.

[b]SHOULDERS:[/b] 

1) Left shoulder is used to destroy everything with a Sword.
2) Right shoulder is used to apply Shield.

[h1] Bigger letters! [/h1]

The letter's size is now 1.5 times bigger which makes them very easy to read. I don't know if they look weird, but after going back to the small size I just couldn't understand what was hidden on them. 

Still, if you want, you may disable the "Big Buttons" function in the "Start the Game" menu by clicking on "Big: On" switch.

[h1] Easier to get 100%! [/h1] 
A few achievements were removed:

1) Two toughest ones (0.3% of all players had it): 
- Beat the game without shortcuts;
- The same but in hard mode;

2) The one which is not working at the moment because the game mechanics have changed - "When the time stops"

[h1] Apart from various bugfixes [/h1]

Now the game has a little bit nicer pause menu.

I thought that it was just disturbing to look at two lines of text and have to press the buttons in order to do something. Thus, now it's a bit better looking.

[h1] Thank you! [/h1] 
I want to thank all of the people who had the patience to wait for the controller support to be implemented to the game! I hope that you will enjoy it! ;) 

See you in the next update! ːnary_shieldː

notes.title: Update #5 - The root of all evil?
notes.content:
[h1]Finally fixed?[/h1]

After tons of attempts, the hated-by-everyone mid-game freeze has finally been elliminated! (hopefully, at least).

The bug itself was caused by "peaceful" and beloved coins!
They used to get stuck in the level layout and crush the game.

I hope that this splinter will never dare to occur again!

[h1]Easy money![/h1]

Considering the circumstances, I've added a new free (doesn't need to be unlocked by achievement) bird Goldy! 

This dude is going to be one of your best friends in Nary because he drops money in front of you!

[h1]Choices![/h1]

In this update I've implemented saving the difficulty choice between the runs. A bit later I'll try to add all of the others ones!

[h1]Good luck, have fun![/h1]

I hope that you'll enjoy your stay!
See you in the next update! ːnary_shieldː

notes.title: Update #4 - I've forgotten the alphabet! :c
notes.content:
[h1]Less buttons - more joy to get?[/h1]

I've looked through the main ideas/complaints/critisism about Nary and tried to implement many of them into the game. 

[h1]No letters???[/h1]

Yes, please! The 6 hp-letters were completely removed from the game and replaced by 4 arrows. Thus, there are much less buttons to press and they are more comfortably placed. Also, the arrows' colour was replaced by a better looking one.

[h1]Herbs, Arrows, Rocks and other stuff[/h1]

Herbs are now collected by directly colliding into them.

Arrows and other stuff enemies shoot is destroyed when you kill its creator.

This way, there are even less buttons to press so that players can focus on the game and not on finding the appropriate keys!

[h1]Last but not least - Random updates[/h1]

1) Levels are ~1/4 smaller;
2) Replenishing hearts now costs 300 instead of 400 coins;
3) Now you don't lose hearts after skipping an enemy, only the multiplier;

And bugfixes, of course.

[h1]Contact me![/h1]

Most of those changes are based on the reviews and discussions players made regarding Nary. 

So, I sincerely hope that in future you'll keep telling me what you would like to see in the game so that I can improve it further and further! 

See you in the next update! ːnary_shieldː

notes.title: Update #2
notes.content:
Latest Changes: 

[h1] "Immediate Start" changes: [/h1]   
1) Now you can skip the story. Right into the action, hell yeah! 

2) No longer completing the tutorial is required to play the game. Nevertheless, I still highly recommend going through it before you start.

[h1] "Slow PC" changes: [/h1]  
1) The levels are not generated every time you die anymore. They are only re-generated when you completely lose all of your hearts. This way, the loading time is ~500% faster. I'm a bit sad that I had to sacrifice some of the randomness and fun for that though. Well, we'll see how this turns out.

[h1] "Not so hardcore" changes: [/h1] 
1) Added special "Novice" adjustment. With its help the new enemies will also not spawn! Thus, you will only have to kill the rest of the foes after dying.

I hope that this update will make the game a bit more enjoyable for you! 
Let me know if you find any bugs, I'll try to fix them ASAP! 

[h1] Your help required! [/h1]   
P.S. This might actually be a buggy one and it cost me a lot of nerves yesterday. Thus, please, if you notice anything weird going on with the game, write about it either under this announcement or in "Bug Reports" topic on forum. Thanks in advance!  ːnary_shieldː

notes.title: Update #1
notes.content:
Nary is finally released! I'm extremely thankful for the Greenlight Community support for making that possible! That's definitely one of the greatest moments in my entire life!

[h1] Back to the bad things though.. [/h1]

Even though I spent quite a while testing the game on my own, after the release I found a few more minor bugs.

Thus, this small update includes the next bugfixes:

[h1] Major Bugfixes [/h1] 
1) It was impossible to take screenshots. I'm really sorry for that, I thought that it was only connected with Nary being not released.

[h1] Minor Bugfixes [/h1] 
1) "Going Home" achievement was not unlocked immediately, the player had to restart the game and wait for some time for the in-game achievement check.

2) "At least you tried.." and "Mirage" achievements were unlockable in the tutorial even though they were not supposed to be.

I hope that you were not affected by those bugs!
See you in the next update! ːnary_shieldː
